title: Encyclopaedia Britannica; or, A dictionary of arts, sciences, and miscellaneous literature - Fourth edition, Volume 14 Part 1, MIC-Moral philosophy - EB.9
text:
_Location._ _JSC-—halbit is not uncommon in every
part of the globe, and in many places it is very strong
dant. It is found in regular columns in several of the
Hendees on the west coast of Scotland, as in County
Tigge, his Schalen like, but particularly beautiful in Staf-
Ry. Pretty regular columns are displayed also a Dunley
and on the Gulfwide field of Arkharkaceae near Edina
burgh 3, but the Giant’s caufevay and the rocks about
Firland on the north coast of Ireland, exhibit the
fuet and south extensive ranges of columnar bafla in
the world.
